arithmetic: Identify every Psi_0=1 state in the frozen 2,752-state finite-exponent F spectrum; run internal gaps, min/max ranked accepted closures, rejected one-step terminal lookahead, external-gap direct certificates, and centered cross-chart certificates; exhaust the complete finite raw-transition reach only for unresolved states; then enumerate every generalized dyadic predecessor and audit its natural marked lift.
scope_note: The 483 states come from 200 frozen pressure primes and are not all core primes. Formal transitions remain analysis evidence. Complete-reach, cross-chart, and final small-gap hits are independently verified direct certificates. All generalized dyadic objects are recorded as unlifted predecessors: they do not satisfy E4 and are not counted in the 479 state-local direct hits or the final verified total.
